# Best waterproof Bluetooth speakers for the pool or beach

**My top pick: JBL Charge 6.** It has an IP68 rating, 20 hours of battery (28 with Playtime Boost), 40W of power, and it can charge your phone. What Hi-Fi named it best overall, and it was about $130 at Walmart and $150 at Amazon when they checked. BestProducts also picked it as best overall. [What Hi-Fi's buying links](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart) · [BestProducts review](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/)

## Other picks by need

- **Loudest, for pool parties: JBL Boombox 4.** RTINGS rates it the best waterproof speaker it has tested. It floats, handles long immersion, and lasts over 40 hours. Its sound is narrow, so it can sound muffled if you sit to the side or behind it. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth)
- **Even sound all around: Ultimate Ears Epicboom.** It's IP67, floats, and lasts about 15 hours. Tom's Guide ranks it best overall, and RTINGS ranks it best mid-range. It's not cheap. [Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-waterproof-speakers)
- **Budget: Ultimate Ears Wonderboom 4.** It's IP67, floats, and gets about 14 hours. BestProducts listed it around $65. [BestProducts](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/)
- **Cheapest: JBL Go 5.** It's IP67 and pocket-sized, at about $40 on Amazon. Battery is only up to 8 hours. [What Hi-Fi](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart)
- **Easy to carry to the beach: JBL Grip.** Good Housekeeping's best overall. It's IP68, can-sized, under a pound, and about $100, with 12 hours of battery. [Good Housekeeping](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/what-to-buy/a71783745/best-waterproof-speakers/)
- **Big and floating: Soundcore Boom 2 Plus.** It's 100W, IPX7, floats, and gets up to 20 hours at half volume, but it weighs 3.8 kg (about 8.4 lb). The list price is $249.99. Dealectric says code AFSC20 brings it to about $200 and that it tested the code on 2026-10-22. Checkout has the final word. That link is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission if you buy through it. [Buy at Soundcore via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-boom-2-plus) · [Details](https://dealectric.com/soundcore-boom-2-plus). The smaller Soundcore Boom 2 floats too, but it has no dust rating, so keep it on a towel at the beach ([BestProducts](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/)).

## Before you buy

- **IP rating:** Aim for IPX7 or higher, and IP67 or IP68 for sand. Good Housekeeping suggests IPX7 at minimum.
- **Salt and chlorine:** IP ratings don't cover corrosion. RTINGS recommends rinsing with fresh water after use. Check your manual first, since some advise against beach or shower use. Keep the charging port closed and let the speaker dry before charging.

I couldn't open the retail pages myself, so prices come from the review sites and may have changed. The review pages above have the current buy buttons for Amazon, Walmart, and Best Buy.

If you tell me your budget and whether you want something pocketable or party-loud, I can narrow it to one.
